d: Six former contestants return and attempt spectacular stunts.
Six women test their fears in three water-based challenges.
Contestants cannot sleep for 48 hours and must compete while fighting exhaustion and diminished capacity.
Four couples must free someone from the trunk of a submerged vehicle and climb down the side of a building to free someone from a car suspended 15 stories above the pavement.
Contestants in the all-female episode must escape from restraints beneath a speeding helicopter and clean their plates when a special meal is served.
A passenger must direct a blindfolded friend to drive their vehicle up the back ramp of a moving automobile carrier and park inside.
Previous winners return to ride bicycles on a 6-inch-wide beam balanced between two speeding trucks and drink juice made from tomato horn worms.
